method: Continuum quartic with weighted bulk integrals; separate sparse full-grid steady solve and augmented affine matrix exponential for each fixed grid, independently assembled in Python; not a reuse of JS upwind/Euler.
caveat: First-cell upwind inlet face vs cell mean gives a half-dx first-order boundary shift even for the continuous linear-x quartic. Product of row mean U and row mean T differs from the continuous weighted bulk at O(dy^2). Fixed-grid exponential verifies temporal integration, not continuous transient spatial accuracy.
